title.narrative: 1. Project title: Building Climate-Resilient Livelihoods through Community-Led Adaptation in Makueni and Kitui Counties

description.narrative:
The project is set to improve the resilience of the semi-arid communities in Kitui and Makueni counties, whose livelihoods are continually being threatened by frequent drought, land degradation, and erratic rainfall patterns due to climate change. Increased access to climate information for communities, improved agroecological farming practices, strengthened local disaster risk governance, and increased adaptive capacity for local communities and institutions are the interventions through which the project will reach its vision. Key interventions will include: i. Training and capacity development of the County and National government stakeholders, Ward Climate Change Planning Teams and Committees,(WCCPC/Ts), Self Help Groups (SHGs), and local farmers on climate resilient agriculture and early warning systems. ii. Facilitating community led climate risk assessment and localized adaptation action planning. iii. Facilitating policy dialogue and building institutional capacity for climate governance at the ward and county levels. iv. Promoting nature based solutions and land management at the ward level while collaborating with the ward natural resource management committees.
The project will take a rights oriented and participatory strategy in making sure that it is inclusive, especially to the women, youth, and people with disabilities. Locally led innovation, knowledge exchange, and capacity building will make sure that the project contributes meaningfully to long term climate sustainability and resilience.
